A simple reminder at the right time

Add Nour to your iPhone Home Screen to receive reminders even when the app is closed.

•No ads, no tracking

Choose your location

Select a city or allow access to your device location. In both cases, the coordinates stay on this device.

The search sends only the entered “city + country” terms to Open-Meteo. It never sends your GPS location.

Your browser will ask for permission. Nour uses the coordinates to calculate prayer times and then stores them locally.

Install Nour on iPhone

Apple allows notifications after the website has been added to the Home Screen.

In Safari, tap the Share button.
Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
Open Nour from its icon and tap “Enable reminders” again.

Privacy and security

  • Your GPS location and selected city remain in this device’s local storage.
  • Prayer times are calculated directly in the app.
  • For background reminders, the server receives only a push subscription and a list of prayer times — never the city or coordinates.
  • No private key or API key is included in public files.
  • City search sends only the entered country and city to Open-Meteo.
